name: codexscientist-codex
description: CodexScientist Codex plugin with MCP-only default research semantics for project-local research state. Codex-native tools handle routine file, shell, Git, test, build, and process work.

interface.shortDescription: MCP-only default for CodexScientist research state.
interface.longDescription: A self-contained Codex CLI plugin exposing project-local research state through scripts/cs_mcp.py as the MCP-only default research control plane. Ordinary file editing/search, shell, Git, tests, builds, and process management remain Codex-native responsibilities. `/goal` is Codex-native; CodexScientist does not implement slash commands.
defaultPrompt: MCP-only default: use CodexScientist MCP `cs_*` tools only for CodexScientist research semantics: quest state, durable user requirements, memory, artifacts, baselines, experiment records, paper/reliability workflows, analysis campaign state, method improvement state, and formal evidence provenance. `/goal` is Codex-native; CodexScientist does not implement slash commands. When Codex is already in goal context, use CodexScientist only as the MCP research loop adapter with project-local state, checkpoint, and resume contracts. Use Codex-native file/search/edit/shell/Git/test/build/process capabilities for routine operation-layer work. Treat `cs_bash_exec` as a provenance tool for formal experiment, baseline, analysis, or paper-facing commands, not as a general shell replacement. Load the codexscientist-codex skill first, then load bundled support skills only when the subtask needs them. Keep the native Codex transport boundary and do not reintroduce protocol-server transport.
